name: browser-use
headline: Self-Evolution - Optimizes AI Skills
short_description: Self-Evolution is a meta-level skill that monitors, analyzes, and optimizes other skills. It benefits operations teams by improving skill performance through quality assessment, feedback learning, pattern discovery, weight optimization, framework evolution, and knowledge transfer. It connects to all other skills and workflows, enhancing their efficiency and effectiveness.
author: Arxchibobo

sections.overview:
skill-self-evolution is a background meta-skill for Claude Code and OpenClaw that automatically collects execution data, learns from user feedback, and tunes the weights and configurations of other skills. It closes the improvement loop by scoring skill outputs across efficiency, tool diversity, error rate, completeness, and token efficiency, then discovers usage patterns and runs A/B tests to evolve skill rules. The skill runs locally with no external data uploads, anonymizes sensitive information, and stores all data on-device. Operations teams benefit from automated quality assessment, pattern discovery, weight optimization, and knowledge transfer across domains—all without manual intervention.
Automatically improve skill performance by analyzing execution data and user feedback
Discover high-confidence usage patterns and apply them across similar domains
Run A/B tests on skill configurations and apply statistically significant improvements
Tune element and tool weights daily using time-decay optimization
sections.setup:

sections.usage:
```
Analyze the performance of my [SKILL NAME] skill over the past [TIME PERIOD] using [METRICS]. Identify patterns in its outputs and suggest optimizations to improve its accuracy and efficiency. Provide a step-by-step plan for implementing these improvements.
```
